description: Put text on or inside a path (Type on a Path tool, or the Area Type tool on a shape). kind path runs the text along the path; area flows it inside the shape. The path becomes the text's path, as with the tools; give keepPath to leave the original in place

contents.description: The text. Use \r for new paragraphs

end.description: Path text: where the text ends, 0 to 1

keepPath.description: Keep the original path as well. Default false

kind.description: path: along the path; area: inside the shape

name.description: Name for the new text frame

orientation.description: Vertical Type on a Path / Vertical Area Type. Default horizontal

start.description: Path text: where the text starts, 0 (path start) to 1 (path end), counted by segments

target.description: One path (not a group or compound path)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: create_path_text
title: Create Path Text
